military.t: 🚨 ISLAMABAD TALKS BEGIN TODAY — Iranian Delegation Arrived
military.d: Iranian delegation arrived Islamabad Friday night (per SNN video): Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf walked down Air Iran plane steps first, followed by FM Abbas Araghchi. US side: VP Vance + special envoy Steve Witkoff + Jared Kushner. Pakistan branding 'The Islamabad Talks.' Pakistan Ambassador to US Rizwan Saeed Sheikh: 'If we get this right, I think we would not have to go anywhere else.' Pakistan deployed hundreds of additional police + paramilitary. Trump told NY Post: 'We're going to find out in about 24 hours.'

military.t: 🚢 Hormuz: Only 2 Ships Friday — Lowest Since Ceasefire
military.d: Per S&P Global Market Intelligence ship tracking (analyzed and shared with NBC News): Only 2 ships passed through Strait of Hormuz Friday. NEITHER were oil or gas tankers. Lowest daily total since ceasefire began. Wed-Thu: 4 each. Tue: 8. Total ~19 in 3 days since ceasefire vs normal ~390 (130-160/day pre-war). Hormuz effectively closed 3 full days into ceasefire. IMF Georgieva: 'We don't truly know what the future holds for transits through the strait of Hormuz.'

military.t: ⚠️ Trump: Warships Reloading 'Best Ammunition Ever Made'
military.d: Trump to NY Post (Fri morning): 'We have a reset going. We're loading up the ships with the best ammunition, the best weapons ever made — even better than what we did previously and we blew them apart... And if we don't have a deal, we will be using them, and we will be using them very effectively.' Trump on Truth Social: 'The Iranians don't seem to realize they have no cards, other than a short term extortion of the World by using International Waterways. The only reason they are alive today is to negotiate!' Also: 'very quickly, you'll see Oil start flowing, with or without the help of Iran.'

military.t: 📊 US March CPI Jumped to 3.3% — War's Inflation Shock
military.d: Per CBS News: US Consumer Price Index jumped to 3.3% annual rate in March, up from 2.4% in February — nearly full percentage point jump matching economist forecasts. Energy costs tied to Iran war the primary driver (Hormuz chokepoint disruption). IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva: 'sharp reversal' in global outlook coming, 'no neat and clean return to the status quo ante.' IMF January forecast was 3.3% for 2026 — now downgrade expected. Implications for Fed rate path AND RBI rate path (May MPC).

military.d: TCS Q4 FY26: Net profit ₹13,750 cr (+12% YoY), revenue ₹70,698 cr, beat estimates. Final dividend ₹31/share. FY26 total ₹110. Stock up 6 sessions. Market cap ₹9.24 lakh cr. Wipro to consider 6th buyback Apr 16. Infosys Q4 next week. FPI ₹8,200 Cr OUT in 2 days of ceasefire (BusinessToday) — relief rally faded fast. Morgan Stanley: 95,000 Sensex target Dec 2026 retained. Jefferies: 'apocalypse postponed' but risk premium remains.

military.d: Lebanese presidency officially confirmed Friday: meeting with Israel in Washington next week to discuss ceasefire and start of negotiations. Lebanese PM Nawaf Salam traveling to DC in coming days. State Dept hosting. Lebanese President Aoun: wants ceasefire FIRST, then direct negotiations. Salam pledged restrict weapons to 'legitimate forces only.' Historic — no diplomatic relations exist. BUT Friday saw continued Israel-Hezbollah strikes: Beirut toll >300, Hezbollah hit Kiryat Shmona 'in response to ceasefire violation,' Israel struck bridge in Lebanon.

military.t: 🇵🇰 Pakistan Defense Min Deletes 'Israel Evil' Post

'Bloodletting continues unabated in Gaza, Iran and now Lebanon,' the post had read. Netanyahu's office: 'outrageous... cannot be tolerated from any government, especially not from one that claims to be neutral arbiter for peace.' Pakistan delicately managing dual role as host + Iran sympathizer.

military.t: 🇰🇷 S.Korea Dispatching Special Envoy to Iran
military.d: South Korean Foreign Ministry told NBC News: will dispatch Ambassador for Polar Cooperation Chung Byung-ha as Special Envoy to Iran 'in the near future.' Focus: 'safety of South Korean nationals, vessels and crews... navigation of all ships.' Growing list of non-US diplomatic engagement: China nudge (Britannica), Russia veto (UN Hormuz), Germany unfroze direct contact (Merz), UK Starmer-Trump military capabilities call, Japan Takaichi-Pezeshkian call, France Barrot concerns, now Korea envoy. Multi-polar architecture replacing US monopoly.

IAEA: 440.9kg of 60% HEU unaccounted since Feb 28 when Iran terminated all IAEA access. Primary at Isfahan tunnel complex (Bulletin of Atomic Scientists: possibly 540kg moved pre-strikes). Fordow deep bunker only 30% damaged — 'greatest proliferation risk.' Hegseth: 'non-negotiable, give voluntarily or face forced removal.' Iran's 10-point plan DEMANDS enrichment rights. Trump told NY Post: 'You're dealing against people that we don't know whether or not they tell the truth. To our face, they're getting rid of all nuclear weapons, everything's gone. And then they go out to the press and say, No, we'd like to enrich.' The core structural deadlock entering today's talks.

EAM Jaishankar visiting UAE Apr 11-12. MEA 'closely following developments.' Foreign Secretary Misri in Washington meeting senior US officials. India quadruple-shielded: 40% Hormuz exposure (vs EU/Japan 50%+), US 30-day Russia waiver, 6-8 weeks fuel stocks, Reliance 2M barrels Iranian crude direct. Iran SNSC: 'until details of this victory are finalized, there is still a need for perseverance and prudence.' nukes.name: Isfahan

nukes.name: Fordow
nukes.info: Fordow Fuel Enrichment Plant — built into mountain near Qom. ONLY 30% damaged despite GBU-57 MOPs. Core facility may be INTACT — 'greatest proliferation risk.' Could host hidden IR-6 centrifuge cascades. IAEA verified 432.3 kg of 60% HEU produced here since Nov 2022. Single IR-6 cascade: 60% → 90% in 10 days. 25 days per weapon worth.

nukes.name: Arak (Khondab)
nukes.info: Heavy-water reactor at Khondab 60% damaged. Plutonium pathway. IAEA monitoring. Not yet operational at full capacity. Strikes set back timeline significantly.

nukes.name: Yazd (Ardakan)
nukes.info: Yellowcake plant struck Apr 3. Early-stage uranium processing disrupted. Front end of fuel cycle disrupted for years.

nukes.name: Parchin
nukes.info: Nuclear weapon component testing near Tehran. 50% damaged. Historical AMAD Project site (pre-2003 weaponization research). IAEA denied access for years.

nukes.info: Iranian missiles hit Arad + Dimona. 100+ injured. IAEA: no damage to facility. Israel estimated 80-90 warheads.

assessment.body:
Day 45 opens with the war's worst single morning for Indian markets since Day 1.

THE COLLAPSE
• After 21 hours of marathon direct talks in Islamabad — first US-Iran face-to-face since 1979 — Vance confirmed no agreement
• Vance press conference before boarding Air Force Two: 'The bad news is that we have not reached an agreement. And I think that's bad news for Iran much more than it's bad news for the US. They have chosen not to accept our terms.'
• Sticking point per Vance: 'We need to see an affirmative commitment that they will not seek a nuclear weapon, and they will not seek the tools that would enable that.'
• Trump Truth Social: 'the meeting went well, most points were agreed to, but the only point that really mattered, NUCLEAR, was not.'
• US red lines per TIME/senior US official: end ALL uranium enrichment, dismantle major enrichment facilities, allow US to retrieve Iran's HEU, end funding for proxies, fully open Hormuz without toll
• Iran demands: frozen asset release ($6B+), continued Hormuz control, right to peaceful enrichment, end Israeli attacks on Lebanon, war reparations
• Iran's Ghalibaf: 'experience with Americans met with failure and broken promises'
• Iran FM spokesman Baghaei: 'excessive demands by America prevented any agreement'
• AFP: Iran says was 'inches away' from deal

THE BLOCKADE
• Trump Truth Social: 'Effective immediately, the United States Navy, the Finest in the World, will begin the process of BLOCKADING any and all Ships trying to enter, or leave, the Strait of Hormuz'
• Called Iran's position 'extortion'
• 'Instructed our Navy to seek and interdict every vessel in International Waters that has paid a toll to Iran'
• 'No one who pays an illegal toll will have safe passage'
• 'We will also begin destroying the mines the Iranians laid in the Straits'
• CENTCOM: blockade 'enforced impartially against vessels of all nations' entering/departing Iranian ports and coastal areas
• CRUCIAL: Still allows ships traveling between non-Iranian ports to transit Hormuz
• Effective Monday 10 AM ET
• Trump to Fox News Sunday Futures: 'civilisation will die' statement 'got them to the bargaining table', 'I predict they come back and give us everything we want'

INDIAN MARKET CARNAGE
• Sensex opened sharply lower Monday
• Crashed nearly 1,700 points (-2%) intraday to 75,868
• Nifty 50 plunged 500 points (-2%) to intraday low 23,556
• ₹8 LAKH CRORE WIPED OUT in minutes
• Total market cap of BSE-listed firms fell from ₹451 lakh crore to ₹443 lakh crore by 9:20 AM
• Nifty Midcap 100 and Smallcap 100 -2% each — broad-based selloff
• Rupee CRASHED 49 paise to 93.32 against USD
• India VIX spiked
• OMC stocks: BPCL, HPCL, IOC all -3 to -4%
• SBI Securities: blockade NEGATIVE for OMCs, airlines, chemicals, paints, tyres, plastics
• Upstream ONGC and Oil India positive (higher crude prices)
• RIL among losers
• IndiGo led airline selloff
• Last week FPI pulled ₹20,700 Cr but DII bought ₹21,600 Cr (cushion)
• Wed's ₹16 LAKH CR wealth creation partially given back

OIL PRICE SHOCK
• Brent crude jumped 8% to around $103/barrel (intraday peak $102.29)
• WTI climbed as much as 9.3% to above $105/barrel (peak $104.24)
• Erased all of last week's -12% Brent decline
• Brent range during war: $70 pre-war → $119 peak → $95 Friday → $103 Monday
• Saudi Arabia RESTORED full pumping capacity through East-West Pipeline to Red Sea
• Saudi also restored Manifa field output
• Limited offset to blockade impact — bypass route
• Asian markets: Nikkei 225, Kospi, Hang Seng all -1 to -1.2%
• US index futures -0.8% pre-open
• Gasoline futures jumped on blockade

IRAN'S RESPONSE
• Ghalibaf returned to Tehran from Islamabad Sunday
• Told reporters: 'If they fight, we will fight, and if they come forward with logic, we will deal with logic. We will not bow to any threats, let them test our will once again so that we can teach them a bigger lesson.'
• Ghalibaf on X: 'Enjoy the current pump figures. With the so-called blockade, soon you'll be nostalgic for $4-$5 gas.'
• Iranian state media (IRIB, Press TV): talks 'stalled on issue of control over Strait of Hormuz and Tehran's right to a peaceful nuclear energy program'
• Ghalibaf also: 'forward-looking initiatives, but the opposing side ultimately failed to gain the trust of the Iranian delegation'
• Iran said 'inches away' from deal (AFP)
• Iran FM Araghchi also reportedly wanted to speak with Europeans in Berlin, Paris, London next

LEBANON TRACK STILL ALIVE
• Netanyahu: campaign against Iran 'not yet over'
• Wants 'real peace agreement that will last for generations' with Lebanon
• Lebanon-Israel talks STILL on for Tuesday in Washington (US mediated)
• Lebanese PM Nawaf Salam: working to stop Israel-Hezbollah war
• Lebanon toll past 2,000 already
• IDF struck rocket launcher in Jouaiyya southern Lebanon Sun
• Israel killed 3 in Nabatieh Sunday
• Hezbollah MP Fadlallah rejects direct Lebanon-Israel talks as 'blatant violation'

INDIA — THE STAKES TESTING
• EAM Jaishankar's UAE visit Apr 11-12 concluded
• Foreign Secretary Misri still in Washington
• Pakistan FM Ishaq Dar urged US-Iran to continue ceasefire despite collapse, characterized 21-hour session as 'intense and constructive'
• India's structural shields being tested in real-time:
  - 40% crude via Hormuz (not 85% some media report) — structural insulation
  - Reliance 2M Iranian barrels direct (Apr 7)
  - Sea Bird Iranian LPG at Mangalore
  - 6-8 weeks fuel stocks
  - US 30-day Russia waiver
  - RBI held 5.25% Apr 8, flagged Hormuz as FY27 drag
  - ZERO LPG dry-outs maintained throughout war
  - 51 lakh cylinders delivered Mon
  - 345 Indian fishermen returned
  - TCS Q4 +12% profit, ₹31 dividend — cushion
• NSE LAUNCHED BRENT CRUDE FUTURES today Apr 13 (coincidentally) — Indian traders can now hedge crude directly via NSE

MARKET COMMENTARY
• Geojit Vijayakumar: 'How this naval blockade, which in effect will be a US blockade of Iran's blockade, will play out remains to be seen... ideal strategy in this ultra-uncertain situation is to wait and watch'
• Enrich Money Ponmudi R: 'earlier relief from temporary ceasefire has reversed... crude oil prices, which had corrected from above $110 to $94-100 range, have now surged back above $105, reintroducing inflationary and macro concerns'
• Choice Equity Aakash Shah: 'sentiment has turned cautious again, market may witness profit booking and volatility, especially if Nifty sustains below 24,000 mark'
• Motilal Oswal Ajay Menon: 'Movements in crude oil prices, the rupee, and FII flows will remain key determinants of near-term market direction'
• Simbal Khan (Asia Foundation): 'I think it's the beginning of the end of this phase of war' — but talks failure makes this less certain

SCENARIO C ACTIVATED — WHAT'S NEXT
The 20% failure case we flagged has activated. The path forward:

1. **Blockade enforcement phase (Days 45-50)**: US Navy begins intercepting Iran-bound tankers. Oil climbs toward $115-120. Sensex tests 74,000-75,000 support. Rupee toward 94-95.

2. **Iranian response options**: (a) asymmetric attack on US warships (escalation); (b) formal withdrawal from ceasefire; (c) quiet diplomacy via China/Russia/Pakistan; (d) 'inches away' position — return to table with face-saving compromise.

3. **Secondary track — Lebanon-Israel Washington talks TUESDAY**: If this track succeeds while Iran track fails, it's a partial off-ramp. Netanyahu wants 'peace agreement for generations.'

4. **Nuclear timeline**: 440.9kg of 60% HEU still unaccounted. Single IR-6 cascade = 60% → 90% in 10 days. Fordow deep bunker only 30% damaged. Iran could rush to breakout under cover of blockade distraction. This is the fear driving US hardline.

BOTTOM LINE
The 'Trump reset' has activated. Markets are now repricing a binary event that resolved DOWN. Monday's -2% intraday crash erases Wednesday's ₹16L Cr rally in a single session. Brent back above $100 reintroduces full inflation + CAD + rupee stress. India's structural shields (40% Hormuz, 6-8 weeks stocks, Reliance Iranian crude direct, DII absorption of FPI outflow, Jaishankar's UAE diplomacy, RBI pause) are about to be tested for the first time with NO diplomatic off-ramp visible. Direction now depends on two variables: (1) does Iran retaliate militarily in Hormuz against US Navy vessels? (2) does Trump actually enforce the blockade or walk it back like the March 5 'power plants and bridges' threat? The 2-week ceasefire technically runs until April 22 — nine days of ambiguity remain. Watch for: Tuesday Lebanon-Israel talks as partial off-ramp; Iran rushing to Europeans (Berlin/Paris/London per Araghchi); China/Russia mediation offer; any incident between US destroyers and IRGC vessels in Hormuz. Indian equities will remain volatile, crude-sensitive, and rupee-correlated until the direction clarifies. Brace for Brent $110+ test if blockade holds to Friday.
